mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% within the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a contraction in the residential sector amid inflationary pressures, reducing household disposable income and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST declines by at least 1% and CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.5% over the prior 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side contraction regime, declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates reduced corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 240 signals high inflation, prompting anticipated monetary tightening and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A real GDP level (GDPC1) above 16500 billion dollars (2017 dollars) indicates a robust economic expansion, supporting strong corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 16500.
